changes_made.explanation: Removed tasks that are not the main focus (Dialogue Generation, Image Captioning). Removed duplicate dataset entry. Consolidated model list to main models used (IDEFICS, GPT-3, InternVL). Simplified output description.
Normalized metric names to standard forms. Simplified ROUGE-L to ROUGE. Used descriptive names for cosine similarity metrics.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper uses LLMs for generation (GPT-3 for CRDG) but not for evaluation/judgment.

Participants are shown the REs in the context of the unfolding dialogue. We, however, show the dialogue up until the end of the current RE for which the participant is asked to provide an answer.

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated multiple guideline descriptions into one clear statement. Kept the single evaluation criterion used in the human evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and minor inconsistencies. The paper focuses exclusively on Referring Expression Generation (REG) as an NLG task, using both automatic metrics and human evaluation. No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The human evaluation specifically measured target identification accuracy in a text-image retrieval task.
